            size_t ui_table_row (char * out, size_t capacity, const
              ui_table_column_t * columns, const char *const * cells,
              size_t count, int width, bool selectable,
              bool selected)
          

          

            Format a complete row without allocation. Styled cells are clipped
            by terminal columns, never by bytes. The caller owns data and
            sorting.
